conditions: The three riskiest rewrites (store kernel+lazy-moves 4475, proxy-zoo replacement 3920, adapter rebuild-deletion 1300) must each land within ~15% of estimate; these carry uncounted replacement costs (hook arrays, stub refs, dynamic-import glue, fields-tree/errors-tree rebuild bytes) and the ~23 kB landing needs all three near-full.

The directive unweld (measured 6,265 gz, the most solid item) must work for compiled SSR component hosts (open spike flagged in the ssr-plugin report) and the store-DOM move (690) is contingent on it landing.

Dev/prod dual-dist with a 'development' export condition must ship, and its 2,554 gz measured win must be re-measured AFTER the unweld/lazy moves (400-500 gz of the leak sits in code other findings already remove).

Do not additionally bank the dev-strings 950 gz error-code finding or the 110 gz symbol diet without first removing the errors.ts prose claims from validation (350) and defensive (480) — the same ~950 chars are claimed by three reports.

Budget ~700-1000 gz for gzip superadditivity: per-file gz-attributed savings sum higher than realized deletion (verified by probe: two 30-key getter forests cost only ~480 gz combined minified+gz because gzip already dedupes the second copy, vs the 650 gz claimed for their removal).

Author sign-offs required on the behavior-changing pieces the totals depend on: history as subpath import, form.field(path) replacing form.fields(path), prod error messages becoming code+URL, adapter data-walk defaults (one-microtask seed timing shift), arrayShapeAtPath made required.
evidence:
Ledger reconstruction verified against phase1-digest.md: every bucket resums exactly from the 14 reports' per-finding numbers (e.g. walkers 2421 = 600+600+631+140+280+110+60; store 4475 = 12 findings incl. the history-contingent 155; proxies 3920 = 5047 minus the correctly-deduped 1127 history claim; strings 2900 = measured 2554 strip + 350 warn-gating, 950 error-code finding correctly excluded). Raw sum 26,971.

Cross-report collisions quantified at ~1,900 gz: errors.ts prose double-claimed by validation(350)+defensive(~410 of 480); paths.ts (698 gz total, verified 13,897 B source) machinery claimed by both walkers(280) and defensive(450) → ~290 overlap; dev-strip 2554 overlaps unwelded/lazified code ~400-500; slim-gate/factory caches claimed by store(120)+defensive(300)+adapters(250) → ~225; registry wizard surface misc(95) inside ssr-plugin(180); error-writer family validation/store ~150; write-funnel/stripSymbolsDeep ~150; patch appliers ~110; resetField strings triple-claim ~100. So the orchestrator's 1500-2500 allowance correctly covers CROSS-REPORT double-counting.

What it does not cover: within-estimate optimism and gzip superadditivity. Ran a synthetic probe (node zlib, minified-style code): one 30-key getter forest = 324 gz, TWO near-identical forests = 482 gz combined (second copy ~160 gz marginal), loop replacement ~100 gz marginal — so the 650 gz mirror claim realistically nets ~350-400. Same gzip-dedup logic deflates the four-proxy-trap-set and variant-switch merges. Source-level probe: forests at build-form-api.ts lines 174-293/711-876 gzip at 0.26 ratio vs 0.31 norm.

Bottom-up floor from the analysts' own ideal designs: kernel 3.0 + paths 0.4 + walkers 1.9 + zod-v4 stack 3.6 + API surface 4.5 + register core 0.8 + validation/display/errors 2.0 + arrays 1.1 + registry 0.5 + misc 0.25 ≈ 18.0-18.5 kB gz — matching ground truth's 17-18 core-floor note. 23 kB is therefore physically achievable with headroom.

Net: 26,971 − 1,900 − ~2,800 (optimism/replacement) − ~800 (gzip) ≈ 21,400 gz savings → landing ≈ 24.0 kB (47%).
notes: Verdict detail: the ~23 kB (50%) headline survives as the optimistic edge of my honest 22.9-25.0 kB landing band, not as a central estimate; expected central landing ~23.5-24.5 kB (~47-48% cut). Notably the claim is internally conservative relative to its own ledger (26,971 − 2,000 would imply landing ~20.3 kB; claiming 23 implies an extra ~2.5k implicit haircut), and that implicit haircut is almost exactly what my optimism+gzip deflation consumes — which is why the number roughly holds. The floor estimate (~18 kB) means a second, harder pass after this program could still find ~3-5 kB more, so 50% is a fair program target even if the first landing is 24 kB.

claim: Directive un-weld: removing vRegister from ensureAttaformInstalled/plugin install saves a measured 6.27 kB gz for non-directive consumers (46.48->40.22), delivered to v-register users via compile-time transform injection and/or a replay-stub directive; SSR keeps sync getSSRProps via a server-condition eager import.
conditions: Server bundles must resolve a build variant where the install path statically imports and app-registers the real directive (export condition node / __SERVER__ define). A stub cannot supply getSSRProps: compiled SSR calls ssrGetDirectiveProps with a name-resolved directive (verified in @vue/compiler-ssr buildSSRProps), and getSSRProps carries aria on both SSR paths plus value/checked on the runtime path. Server-eager import satisfies this fully.

The 'compiled v-model pattern' is NOT literally available: compiler-core registerRuntimeHelpers imports helpers only from module 'vue' (runtimeModuleName), so client delivery for compiled users needs new mechanism - component-local directives:{register:vRegister} injection by the vite/nuxt plugin (clean, works for client AND SSR compiles of that component), a compiled-output resolveDirective('register') rewrite, or a module-slot stub armed by a transform-injected side-effect import. Requires a spike, including the component-host (SSR_COMPONENT_HOST_MODIFIER) parity path the phase-1 report itself leaves OPEN.

Replay-stub timing must be redesigned or scoped: 'one microtask' is false for a code-split chunk in production (network fetch). During the load window listeners are unattached and the replayed mounted seed syncs storage->DOM, potentially clobbering input typed into the visible field. Mitigations: capture el.value at replay as user input, preload on registry install, or prescribe sync installVRegister(app) for the no-build population. Webpack/vue-cli consumers get NO template transforms (src/webpack.ts docblock: vite transforms 'do not transfer'), so they are entirely in this fallback bucket.

Accounting: on the minimal-v4 eager metric this finding is mutually exclusive with the directive-internal findings (file 347, host-machinery 440, table-kernel 550, SSR-strip 490, async-transform 300 - all bytes inside the 6,255); count once. Small overlap (~200-300 gz) with the dev/prod dual-dist finding (2,554): assigner-pipeline's dead if(!1) warn block and directive.ts checkbox warn strings sit inside the removed cluster. NO overlap with the store dom-binding 690B move (create-form-store and register-api verified still eager in the stubbed build).

Zero-config DX decision: if a ~150-250 B gz stub stays registered by ensureAttaformInstalled to preserve zero-config no-build v-register, net drops to ~6.0-6.1 kB; if the install path registers nothing (installVRegister-only fallback), the full 6.25 kB stands but no-build v-register users break until they add one line (api:public, needs Oswald sign-off).

A realistic v-register-using app reclaims ~0 of these bytes on its form route (the cluster relocates into the component chunk via transform delivery); the un-weld's win accrues to non-directive consumers, headless register()-spread forms (register-api stays eager and works without the directive), injectForm-only routes, and first-paint TTI ordering. The further ~1.6-2.1 kB for directive users comes from the separate internal splits, not this finding.
evidence: Replicated the measurement with an independent esbuild experiment (scratchpad/verify-unweld.mjs, same method as scripts/check-eager-size.mjs, onLoad stub of plugin.ts removing only the vRegister import + app.directive line): baseline 46,477 gz -> stubbed 40,222 gz, delta 6,255 (claimant 6,265). Metafile diff shows exactly the directive cluster removed (directive.ts, directive-aria/file/listeners/lifecycle/value-sync, register-protocol, assigner-pipeline, vue-shared-shim); zero modules added; create-form-store and register-api remain eager - so no double count with the store dom-binding 690B finding, and register-api's 1,086 gz correctly stays (build-form-api.ts:47 imports buildRegister). Import-graph check: src/runtime/core/plugin.ts:4 is the ONLY outside-cluster importer of directive files; ensureAttaformInstalled is called from use-abstract-form.ts:23-anchored path plus use-form-context.ts:15, inject-wizard.ts:4, use-register.ts:72. SSR: directive.ts:1456-1516 getSSRProps carries aria (both paths) and value/checked (runtime path; compiled SSR skips form-state via the null-vnode guard because the transform injected the binding). @vue/compiler-ssr buildSSRProps (compiler-ssr.cjs.js:556) emits ssrGetDirectiveProps(_ctx, ...buildDirectiveArgs) with name-based resolveDirective - server app registration is mandatory; the claimed server-condition eager import satisfies it. Semantic trap: compiler-core registerRuntimeHelpers (compiler-core.cjs.js:132) + runtimeModuleName='vue' (:3705) means codegen helpers import ONLY from 'vue' - the 'compiled v-model pattern' cannot be reused verbatim; client delivery needs new plugin machinery. src/webpack.ts docblock confirms webpack/rspack ship only the adapter rewrite, no template transforms. register-api.ts:106 catch-up probe (autofocus race) exists as claimed. Timing: import() of a split chunk is a network fetch, not a microtask; replayed mounted seed can clobber typed input.
notes: Verdict: the byte number is real and independently reproduced; the deflation is in the delivery story, not the measurement. The headline mechanism (un-weld + server-eager SSR) is sound; the client-side transform injection is feasible but mischaracterized as an existing Vue pattern and needs a spike (component-local directive registration injected by the vite/nuxt plugin is the cleanest route found). The replay stub's microtask-safety claim is false under real chunk loading and needs an input-preserving replay or a sync installVRegister prescription for no-build users. Adjusted 6,100 assumes a small eager stub survives for zero-config DX; use 6,255 if the install path registers nothing. On the whole-audit ledger, do not also credit the directive-internal split findings against the minimal-v4 metric, and shave ~200-300 gz if summing with the dev/prod dual-dist finding.

name: Architect B: Clean Sheet ("Kernel and Ports")
thesis: Attaform v1.0 is rebuilt as a small trusted kernel (plain state record, one interned-path write descent, one tagged error store, hook slots) surrounded by feature modules that attach only when their entry is imported: binding, wizard, history, SSR, activation, and async transforms all leave the useForm graph. The public surface drops the callable-proxy design: values is a native readonly reactive, errors is a memoized plain tree, fields keeps dot-drill via one lean proxy, and call forms become ordinary methods. The zod layer becomes one shared engine plus per-major probe packs with no schema reconstruction, so dual-major support costs under 2 kB instead of 5.5. With a pre-stripped dev/prod dual dist, minimal-v4 eager lands at a budgeted 19 kB gz (17.65 kB itemized plus 1.35 kB reserve), a 58% cut, while every current capability stays reachable and keystroke/mount work drops (one walk per write, shared methods, cached binding ports).
target_architecture:
MODULE MAP (src/runtime unless noted; budgets in the eager table).

Kernel: `state.ts` defines FormState, a plain record ({form ref, fields Map, errors Map (tagged), blankPaths, originals, authored, lifecycle refs, schema adapter, resolved opts, hooks}); construction and reset() are the same initialize() with a delta flag. `path.ts` is a per-store interning trie: pathOf(dotted | segs) returns the unique frozen {segs, key, parent}; equality is ===, JSON round-trips and the FIFO caches disappear; strings are minted only at serialized edges. `write.ts` is the single funnel: rim mints a PathRef once, one resolveNode(path) lookup returns {slimKinds, isPreprocess, du, required, emptyValue}, then ONE schema-guided descent gate-checks, completes structure, marks blank/authored, and emits patches against current storage; commit consumes the patch list (no re-diff). Capability flags (hasDU, transforms registered, dom attached) computed once skip whole stages. `errors.ts`: one Map<PathNode, TaggedError[]> with src schema|user; blank derives from blankPaths + required on read; one forEachError iterator replaces six merge loops; writers are three shared functions. `validate.ts`/`submit.ts`: one imperative validation shell; reactive validate() is a 20-line wrapper; parse(path?, {commit}) absorbs validateAsync; handleSubmit keeps its exact semantics and lazy-imports the focus policy through a hook the binding module installs. `display.ts`: the existing engine merged into one module, unchanged behavior. `value-walk.ts`: raw get/set/has/delete over one validated-descent helper plus ONE reconcile(schema, path, value, mode) engine serving construction fill, setValue completion, unset expansion, hydration merge, and intersection merge. `schema-walk.ts`: walkers dispatch on a WeakMap-cached normalized node() (8 structural kinds) instead of 25 wrapper arms. `arrays.ts`: one remap engine (remapForOp, relocateKeys, permuteList, one index scan) plus tokenAt/realign and the field-array API. `variants.ts`: DU guard, reshape, stubs, and variant memory in one module with one clone walk, installed by the adapter when introspection finds a union (eager bytes, runtime skipped when hasDU is false). `field-state.ts`: one builder (leaf = degenerate container, O(1) leaf error fast path), memoized identity. `form-api.ts` + `trees.ts`: form.values = readonly(state.form); form.errors = computed sparse tree; form.fields = one ~90-line lazy proxy; form.meta generated by a defineProperty loop over the exported FIELD_STATE_KEYS; activation moves into kernel entry points (no gated() wrappers). `registry.ts`: plugin+ssr fused, one makeTracker, plain pendingHydration, no wizard slice. `diag.ts`: dev flavor only; prod throws AttaformError(code) + attaform.dev/e URL.

Adapters: `zod-core.ts` (shared engine: peel family, tree-walk predicates, issue mapping, fieldMeta, strict-defaults as a data-walk fix pass over derived values; a prototype class ZodSchemaAdapter, no services object) + `v4-pack.ts`/`v3-pack.ts` (~28 two-line accessors, kind table as data, async predicates, safeParse glue, UNSUPPORTED list). No strip/rebuild/clone anywhere; v4 loses its only value-import of zod. attaform/abstract keeps the AbstractSchema interface (node(), arrayShapeAtPath and slim kinds required; fingerprint removed).

Binding (`attaform/bind`, zero eager): dispatcher + table-driven variant records {events, read, write} over one shared listener/force-sync/identity-guard core; per-path FieldPort cache makes register() identity-stable; lazy arms for component-host, file, and async-transform; SSR props behind a server export condition. The compile transform (one merged NodeTransform) rewrites v-register into withDirectives with a direct import from attaform/bind, so the chunk lives with the components that use it; form.register(path, opts) stays on the form as a ~100 B descriptor the bind module upgrades at load (transform guarantees ordering); no-build consumers call installVRegister(app).

Entries: ".", "./zod-v4", "./zod-v3", "./abstract", "./bind", "./wizard" (form-less affordance steps, gate spine tree-shaken unless gate imported), "./history" (snapshot-ring plugin factory passed as the history option value), "./ssr", "./nuxt", "./vite", "./plugin" (rollup/esbuild/webpack/rspack), "./transforms", "./devtools-panel". Dual prod/dev dist via the "development" condition. Dropped: "./types", "./zod", the require condition, sourcemaps, CJS, two d.ts flavors.

Disappears: 8 proxy files, the rebuild cluster, 4 duplicate schema walkers and 3 reconcile twins, JSON PathKey machinery, ByKey method twins, the 90-key store literal, gated()/getter forests, the four 30-key mirrors, noop wizard forms, delta history, stripSymbolsDeep, deep hydration guards (version stamp instead), probe fallback, per-entry formKey, prod prose, dead modules.

migration_phases: P0 Packaging config (sourcemap:false, emitCJS:false, declaration:'node16', files-field guards, tarball ratchet ~350 kB): tarball 1.8 MB to ~282 kB measured; zero source changes, lands alone

P1 Dev/prod dual dist + 'development' export condition + error-code prod messages + hardened dev-dce structural test: eager 45.4 to ~41.9 kB (2,554 B measured leak + ~950 B prose); docs error-code pages land with it

P2 Binding de-weld: attaform/bind entry, merged compile transform injects the import, installVRegister fallback, DOM/focus leave the store behind hooks, FieldPort cache, lazy host/file/async-transform arms: eager to ~34.9 kB (6,265 B measured + ~0.7 kB store-side); used-path binding cost drops 7.1 to ~3.0-3.5 kB

P3 Path interning + trust-boundary rim (PathRef minted once, inverse caches and ByKey twins deleted, canonicalizePath test gate retired): eager to ~34.4 kB; keystroke drops from 6-10 path serializations to reference reads; enabler for P4

P4 Store kernel rewrite (plain FormState + hook slots, single-walk write funnel feeding patches to commit, one tagged error store with derived blank, construction=reset, capability flags) + arrays engine merge + variants consolidation: eager to ~31.5 kB; characterization suites pinned first, both zod majors green

P5 Schema layer: normalized node() introspector, zod-core + per-major probe packs, delete the rebuild cluster, prototype adapter class, field-meta registration-side install, probe fallback removed: eager to ~27.5 kB; barrel dual-adapter penalty 5.5 to <2 kB

P6 Form API: readonly values, computed error tree, lean fields proxy, FIELD_STATE_KEYS loop-generation, unified FieldState builder, pickDefined, activation folded into kernel entry points, adapter-entry collapse: eager to ~23.5 kB; docs sweep for call-form migration rides along

P7 Feature entries: attaform/history snapshot-ring plugin (-1.3 kB), attaform/wizard with form-less steps + gate spine split + registry slim (-0.3 kB eager), validation shell fold + lazy focus policy (-0.7 kB), attaform/ssr + Nuxt .server/.client plugin pair + hydration stamp (-0.5 kB): eager to ~20.2 kB

P8 Sweep and lock: formKey drop, display merge, shared groupBy/guard helpers, dead-module deletion, d.ts two-tier comment policy + audience split, re-baseline ratchets (eager budget 20,000 B, tarball ~450 kB with the dev flavor): eager lands ~19.0 kB
top_risks: Estimate optimism on the three rewrite-heavy lines (kernel 3.0, zod-core 2.4, form API 1.4): mitigated by the 1,350 B reserve and per-phase ratchet re-baselining; if kernel lands at 3.6 the total is still under 20

Write-funnel semantics regressions: phase ordering (blank/authored marks before identity short-circuit), same-tick DU reshape (no-flicker suite), blur-dedup value-equality, and schema-first error order are all locked behaviors; characterization suites must be pinned green on both zod majors before P4 starts

Transform-delivered directive: the component-host SSR compile (SSR_COMPONENT_HOST_MODIFIER) needs a spike proving withDirectives-with-value drives getSSRProps on that path; no-build/CDN consumers regress to one explicit installVRegister line

TS2589/Volar fragility: the v4 SupportedRootSchema arm, _zod brand, StorageShape property-access pattern, and escape-arm scaffolding must carry over verbatim through the adapter rewrite; the bundled-types fixtures and the playground's CDN-TS worker are the canaries

Dev/prod dual dist depends on consumers resolving the 'development' condition: Nuxt (vite + webpack builders) and Vitest resolution must be verified; bundlers that ignore it silently serve prod in dev (warnings vanish), needing a documented escape hatch

Data-walk strict-defaults changes observable timing: sync-check seeds on schemas that also contain an async refine surface one microtask post-construction, and unknown constraint keys are preserved rather than stripped; needs re-baselined adapter suites and Oswald's sign-off per the reference-before-API-change rule
Docs/demos churn is the largest labor item: ~1,400 fields-dot uses survive but ~560 call-form uses and every v-register/no-build recipe migrate; page-review cadence applies
Interned path trie lifetime: per-store scoping bounds growth to live form shape, but wizard/injectForm cross-store reads must not leak nodes across registries
rejected_ideas: Lazy-loading the array mutation half on first array detection (~500 B): a structural op racing the chunk degrades to positional identity, silently bleeding per-element state one slot; violates the no-silent-degradation stance for a small win

Runtime lazy adapter selection for the '.' barrel: useForm is synchronous and introspection must run before first paint; instead the probe-pack shrink makes the dual-eager penalty <2 kB and build plugins alias to one major
Making '.' v4-only with v3 throwing a pointer: demotes zod-v3 from first-class, contradicting the parity commitment; the marginal v3 pack at ~1.2 kB removes the motivation

Keeping wizard in the main entry (wizard agent's recommendation): correct that it saves 0 eager bytes, but clean-sheet subpath placement trims whole-entry size-limit numbers and per-entry d.ts, and Nuxt auto-imports erase the DX difference

Dynamic-importing the DU/variants module for union-free schemas: the same-tick reshape and rememberVariants default-true contracts require sync install; adopted the eager-bytes/runtime-skip compromise instead
Symbol.for description diet (~110 B): real debuggability cost in devtools for near-noise savings

Replacing unbuild with per-entry builds: re-creates solved problems (single registry-module identity across 12 entries, v3 alias rewrite, jiti stub dev flow) for zero tarball gain beyond the config fixes
Minifying dist for npm: consumer bundlers minify anyway; unminified output is the node_modules debugging story, doubly load-bearing once sourcemaps stop shipping
An eager buffering shim to preserve config-only useForm({history:{max}}): ~150 B forever on every consumer to save one import line for an opt-in feature; the plugin-value API is strictly cleaner

Build-time schema descriptor compilation (moving introspection to the transform): dynamic runtime-built schemas are a first-class commitment, which kills any design requiring schemas to be statically visible

name: Kernel & Capabilities (Architect A)
thesis: Attaform becomes a hooks-kernel: a plain FormState record plus store-first-arg functions, where every optional capability attaches through an explicit channel — compile-time (directive), import-gated sync (history plugin, wizard gate, field-meta), lazy-inside-an-async-moment (focus, activation, async transforms), or SSR-conditional (serialize/hydration replay) — so a minimal form pays only for the kernel it exercises. Three unifications collapse the semantic duplication that phase 1 found written four-plus times: one interned-path/walker layer (normalized schema nodes + one reconcile engine), one zod-core over two thin per-major probe packs, and one callable-tree proxy factory that keeps the callable-read API at roughly a third of today's proxy bytes. A dev/prod dual dist behind a "development" export condition makes DCE deterministic instead of hoping consumer bundlers fold __DEV__ (measured 2.55 kB leak today). Observable behavior — the useForm handle, v-register, callable reads, schema→blank→user error ordering, field.blank — is preserved while storage merges to one tagged error map. Projected minimal-v4 eager: 22.0 kB gz (from 45.4), including a 1.65 kB integration reserve.
target_architecture:
ENTRY LAYOUT. Exports: "." (unified zod, runtime dispatch — penalty drops to <2 kB once the marginal adapter is a probe pack), "./zod-v4", "./zod-v3", "./abstract", "./nuxt", "./vite", "./transforms", per-bundler plugin entries, "./devtools-panel", plus NEW "./directive" (vRegister + installVRegister), "./history" (historyPlugin), "./ssr" (renderAttaformState/hydrateAttaformState). "./types" dropped. Wizard stays in main entries (measured: tree-shakes to 0 eager). Every runtime entry ships prod+dev flavors behind a "development" condition; SSR-only code (getSSRProps, ssr aria/form-state props, serialize) behind node/server conditions. Packaging: sourcemap off, emitCJS off (./nuxt ESM-only), single .d.mts with two-tier comment policy, files-negation guards + tarball ratchet (~0.4 MB packed including the dev flavor).

MODULE MAP (eager, minimal-v4; bytes in eager_budget). Primitives: path (interning trie — pathOf() returns THE frozen {segs, key, parent} node; equality is ===; Maps key on nodes; strings minted only at serialized edges, one edge-parser kept for SSR/wizard-URL payloads); value-walk (get/has/set/tryInPlaceLeafWrite over one validated-descent helper + ONE reconcile(schema, node, value, mode) engine whose mode flags cover construction fill, setValue completion, unset expansion, sparse hydration, intersection merge — replacing mergeStructural, setAtPathWithSchemaFill, unset-walker, merge-hydration, merge-deep); schema-walk (introspector gains node(schema) → {kind: 8-way, children, flags}, WeakMap-cached peel; descend/derive-default/slim-kinds dispatch on 8 kinds, not ~25 wrapper arms; arrayShapeAtPath/getSlimPrimitiveTypesAtPath required, probe fallback deleted); hash/humanize/field-ids; diag (prod: AttaformError(code) + attaform.dev/e URL; prose lives in the dev flavor only).

Kernel: plain FormState record — form ref, fields Map, ONE tagged error Map (src: schema|user; blank derived at read from blankPaths + isRequiredAtPath; per-key schema→blank→user order and field.blank unchanged; three shared fns writeErrors/clearErrors/forEachError replace 7 writer methods and 6 merge loops), originals, blankPaths, lifecycle refs, resolved opts, hooks (ordered arrays: write/commit/reset/dispose), capability flags computed once from introspection (hasDU, hasTransforms, hasArrays). initialize() serves construction AND reset. write(state, node, value, meta) is ONE schema-guided descent doing gate+strip-check+complete+author+patch-emit against current storage; commit consumes the patch list — no re-diff, no stripSymbolsDeep. Validation scheduling stays kernel.

Core eager features (sync-on-write or universally observable): display (state+engine merged); arrays (one engine: remapForOp/relocateKeys/permuteList/scanKeysAtIndex + render half; mutation stays eager — no race degradation); validate (single imperative shell, reactive validate() a thin wrapper, unified parse, submit pipeline); schema-io (slim-gate + coerce over one per-store SchemaNode cache {slimKinds, isPreprocess, du, required, emptyValue} — one lookup per write); variants (DU reshape + stubs + memory, one shared clone walk; bytes eager because dynamic schemas forbid build-time knowledge and reshape is sync same-tick; work flag-gated).

API layer: form-api (plain literal; FIELD_STATE_KEYS drives meta via defineProperty loop; activation folded into store entry points — gated() and activation getters deleted); field-state (one builder, leaf = degenerate container, O(1) leaf error fast-path preserved); surfaces — ONE callableTree factory (function target, array-target swap for renderList, apply → resolve(pathNode), coercion quartet defined once, ownKeys live, toJSON via per-store-change memoized computed tree, child cache keyed on interned nodes) instantiating values/fields/errors and the wizard record surfaces: callable reads fully preserved; register (per-path FieldPort cache — computeds/coerce/store delegates built once per path, RV identity stable; element-registration surface lives here, not in the kernel); createForm core with thin per-adapter entries and shared bindConsumer for injectForm; registry (plugin+ssr merged, one makeTracker, wizard surface lazy-installed, and registers only a ~150 B replay-stub directive).

Zod: zod-core (shared walkTree over pack.children; peel/required/DU/meta family once; issue mapping; strict defaults = derive + data-walk fix pass — all strip/rebuild/clone machinery deleted, v4 loses its zod value-import; one withMeta; lazy sub-schema stub; one shared lazy fingerprint walker) + per-major probe packs (~28 accessors, kind table as data, 2 async predicates, safeParse glue, UNSUPPORTED list) + prototype ZodSchemaAdapter (services object deleted; methods shared across forms).

CAPABILITY ATTACHMENT. (a) Compile-time: vite/nuxt transforms rewrite v-register → withDirectives with a direct attaform/directive import (Vue's compiled v-model pattern; both client and SSR compiles); the replay-stub covers no-build apps. (b) Import-gated sync: historyPlugin option value (snapshot-ring rewrite), wizard gate() marker carrying its spine, walk-field-meta installed by the withMeta module. (c) Lazy inside async moments: focus-first-error (submit), activation/async defaults (activate()), async-transform runtime (first thenable), host/file binding chunks. (d) SSR-conditional: hydration replay + guards on the registry payload path; serialize in ./ssr + server flavor.

DISAPPEARS: directive and history welds; strip/rebuild/clone schema machinery; derivedBlankErrors + dual writer families; five proxy files; four hand-written 30-key mirrors; four array-op switches + three relocation walkers; four wrapper-peel copies; the triple path representation + FIFO caches; gated()/activation getters; the services layer; stripSymbolsDeep; the construction/reset twin; ~4.1 kB dev mass from prod; maps/CJS/d.ts-triplicate from the tarball.

eager_budget.note: Interned path trie: pathOf() -> unique frozen {segs,key,parent}; === equality; replaces paths.ts (698) incl. both FIFO caches, segmentsForPathKey, coerceToPathKey, keyForSegments; one edge-parser kept for serialized payloads

Raw ops (get/has/set/tryInPlaceLeafWrite, one validated-descent helper) + ONE reconcile(schema,node,value,mode) engine; replaces path-walker core + unset-walker + merge-hydration + merge-deep (~2.0 kB today); deleteAtPath/patch appliers move to history chunk

Normalized-node introspector (WeakMap peel cache) + descend/derive-default/slim-kinds on 8 structural kinds; replaces walk-path-segments + walk-derive-default + walk-slim-primitives (2,238 today); walk-field-meta (631) leaves eager via registration-side install
Kept as-is (field ids, label fallback) + slimmed field-meta-store (lists WeakMap + 2 fns); identity memoized per path (perf)
Error classes keep instanceof identity; prod = AttaformError(code)+URL template + public atta: codes; prose in dev flavor only (errors.ts 852+error-codes 136 today)

FormState record; initialize()=reset(); single-walk write funnel emitting patches (subsumes diff-apply 914 + setValueAtPath walks); commit consumes patches; validation scheduling; tagged single error store w/ 3 shared fns; hooks; capability flags
display-state + display-engine merged (663 today); test introspection behind __DEV__; single-timer model preserved verbatim

One merged engine (remapForOp/relocateKeys/permuteList/scanKeysAtIndex) + field-array API + render half (tokenAt et al); replaces array-identity/state-migrate/bookkeeping/field-arrays + variant-memory/store op switches (~1.85 kB today); mutation stays eager
process-form at ~60%: runImperativeValidation single shell, reactive validate() thin wrapper, unified parse, submit pipeline w/ shared groupByCanonicalKey; invalid-submit focus policy lazy
slim-gate + schema-coerce merged (1,316 today) over one per-store SchemaNode cache {slimKinds,isPreprocess,du,required,emptyValue}; one lookup per write replaces ~5 path-keyed caches

DU reshape + du-stubs + variant memory + ancestor guard in one module, one shared clone walk (~1.13 kB today); bytes eager (dynamic schemas), work skipped via hasDU flag; rememberVariants default-true intact

build-form-api (2,755 today) as plain literal: FIELD_STATE_KEYS-driven meta via defineProperty loop (kills both getter forests), activation folded into store entry points, pickDefined() for option spreads, history/wizard namespace stubs
field-state-api (1,828 today): one builder, leaf = degenerate container, O(1) leaf error fast-path and P3 blankPaths reactivity carve-out preserved; single forEachError read path

ONE callableTree factory (apply trap, array-target swap for renderList, coercion quartet once, memoized computed JSON tree, interned-node child cache) serving values/fields/errors + wizard records; replaces 7 proxy files (3,196 today); callable reads KEPT
register-api (1,086 today) with per-path FieldPort cache (stable RV identity, ~12 fields) + element-registration store surface moved here from kernel; focus machinery lazy
use-abstract-form + use-form collapsed to one createForm core (1,089+ today); per-adapter entries are thin adapt() wrappers; bindConsumer shared with injectForm; no history import
registry + plugin.ts + ssr.ts merged (589 today): one makeTracker, wizard surface lazy-installed, pendingHydration plain Map, ~150 B replay-stub directive registration (compile transform bypasses it)

Shared engine: walkTree over pack.children (async/container predicates, assert), peel/required/DU family, issue mapping, strict-defaults derive + data-walk fix pass (NO rebuilds - v4 strip.ts 1,547 deleted), one withMeta, lazy sub-schema stub + pathNeedsAsync, shared lazy fingerprint

Probe pack: ~28 two-line def accessors, kind table as data (def.type mostly identity), isAsyncCheck-exact predicate, safeParse glue, UNSUPPORTED list, version assert; v3 pack is the same shape (~1.1 kB, not on this path)

Prototype ZodSchemaAdapter absorbing abstract-schema-factory (1,313 today): methods on prototype shared across forms, services object deleted, caches on instance; attaform/abstract keeps the interface for custom adapters

Chunk/export glue + estimate risk on the three least-certain budgets (kernel, surfaces, zod-core); consumed only if modules land over budget - target still holds at <=23 kB if fully spent plus ~1 kB more

api_changes.change: History becomes an import-gated plugin: useForm({ history: historyPlugin({ max }) }) from 'attaform/history'; the config-only { history: { max } } form is removed. form.history namespace stubs remain for non-users.
api_changes.why: Only way to get 1.3 kB gz (history + its private diff/path helpers) off every consumer's eager path while keeping construction synchronous (no missed-delta window that a dynamic import would create).

api_changes.change: v-register delivery: build-plugin users (vite/nuxt) are untouched and automatic (transform rewrites to withDirectives with a direct attaform/directive import). No-build apps run through a ~150 B replay-stub that loads the directive chunk on first use (one-microtask-late first value seed on client-only render-function mounts) or call installVRegister(app) from 'attaform/directive' for fully-sync behavior.
api_changes.why: The single largest measured lever: -6,265 B gz for every non-directive consumer; directive users move the cost to the components that bind fields. Stub keeps zero-config working; SSR imports eagerly so getSSRProps stays sync.

api_changes.change: SSR helpers move to 'attaform/ssr' (renderAttaformState, hydrateAttaformState, serialized-state types); the main barrel stops exporting them. Nuxt users unaffected (runtime plugin imports internals).
api_changes.why: Barrel hygiene + whole-entry size; bare-Vue SSR recipe changes one import specifier.

api_changes.change: ValidationError drops per-entry formKey; the wizard stamps it at aggregation (it already fallback-stamps). Error storage merges to one tagged map internally - the observable three-channel behavior (schema->blank->user order per key, field.blank, atta: codes, error-order-schema-first) is unchanged.
api_changes.why: formKey is constant within a form; removing it shrinks every construction site across core + both adapters plus history/hydration payloads, and the single tagged store deletes 6 triple-map merge loops and a dual writer family.

api_changes.change: Prod error/warn text becomes '[attaform] AF## <attaform.dev/e/AF##>'; full prose ships only in the dev flavor via the new "development" export condition. Classes and codes are stable; message text documented as non-API.
api_changes.why: ~2.0 kB raw of tutorial prose currently ships in prod for developer-misuse throws; Vue/React's exact model. Requires the docs error pages to exist first.

api_changes.change: validateAsync folds into parse(path?, { commit? }) as the one imperative validation API (parse stays async per the locked no-sync stance).
api_changes.why: The two methods differ only in flags and a data-stripping projection; one API deletes stripData, a response type, and a docs page while returning strictly more information.

api_changes.change: AbstractSchema SPI tightens: arrayShapeAtPath, getSlimPrimitiveTypesAtPath, and the new node() normalized-introspection method become required; the services object disappears; fingerprint becomes a shared lazy helper. Full contract docs move to an 'authoring adapters' page.
api_changes.why: Deletes the 1M-index probe fallback and the per-adapter walker duplication; affects third-party adapter authors (the bring-your-own-components wedge) so it is the one genuinely breaking contract - pre-1.0 is the time.

api_changes.change: Schema fields literally named toString/hasOwnProperty/call/apply/bind become documented-unsupported on the callable surfaces, and the sucrase .call/.apply downlevel shims are dropped (REPL playground needs a pin/verify).
api_changes.why: The arbitration + shim stack is pure compensation bytes for exotic keys no real schema uses; callable reads themselves are kept.

api_changes.change: Wizard affordance (string) steps become form-less: wizard.forms['intro'] returns undefined instead of a noop form handle; string-slot gates clear on advance-acknowledge.
api_changes.why: Kills a synthesized AbstractSchema + full FormStore closure per intro/review screen; matches the documented 'clears on acknowledgment' gate semantics. Off the eager path but part of the coherent capability design.

migration_phases: Phase 0 - Packaging + dual dist (no runtime restructure): sourcemap off, emitCJS off (./nuxt ESM-only), declaration:'node16', files-negation guards + tarball ratchet -> 1.8 MB to ~0.4 MB packed. Build prod/dev flavors with a "development" export condition; harden dev-dce.test structurally; __DEV__-gate the stray warn sites; error-code prod messages (docs /e/ pages land first). Eager: -~3.9 kB -> ~41.5 kB. Update check-eager-size to resolve the prod flavor.

Phase 1 - Directive un-weld: registry registers only the replay-stub; vite/nuxt transforms emit withDirectives + direct import from new 'attaform/directive'; SSR-only directive code behind the server condition; spike the component-host (SSR_COMPONENT_HOST_MODIFIER) compiled-SSR rewrite before landing. Eager: -~6.3 kB (measured) -> ~35.2 kB.

Phase 2 - Capability subpaths: 'attaform/history' plugin + snapshot-ring rewrite (patch appliers move into its chunk), invalid-submit focus policy lazy inside the async submit, walk-field-meta registration-side install, 'attaform/ssr' + hydration replay/guards onto the registry payload path. Eager: -~2.3 kB -> ~32.9 kB.

Phase 3 - zod-core + probe packs: delete strip/rebuild/clone machinery (data-walk fix pass, async-refine seeds defer one microtask - needs Oswald sign-off + re-baselined characterization), kindOf as data, shared walkTree/peel/issue-map/withMeta, prototype adapter class, v3 sub-schema stub. Eager: -~3.4 kB -> ~29.5 kB; barrel both-adapters penalty 5.5 -> <2 kB.

Phase 4 - Walkers + paths: interned path trie threaded through core (PathRef at the rim, ByKey twins deleted), normalized-node introspector, one reconcile engine over the five value-merge boundaries, SchemaNode per-path cache, lazy mergeStructural default (per-keystroke schema walk removed). Eager: -~2.5 kB -> ~27.0 kB.

Phase 5 - Kernel store rewrite: FormState record + store-first-arg functions + hooks; single-walk write funnel feeding patches to commit; construction=reset; tagged single error store; lazy activation + async-transform runtime; DOM surface moves into register; capability flags; stripSymbolsDeep deleted. Eager: -~3.0 kB -> ~24.0 kB. Characterization suites pin funnel phase order; run both zod majors.

Phase 6 - API layer: form-api plain literal + FIELD_STATE_KEYS loops + activation fold; unified field-state builder; callableTree surface factory replacing the proxy zoo (callable reads kept); register FieldPort cache; arrays engine merge; display merge; registry merge + wizard surface out. Eager: -~2.0 kB -> ~22.0 kB projected (budget table is the authority; phase deltas overlap slightly).

Phase 7 - Polish (0 eager delta): 5-to-1 build-transform merge + ssr-accessed prefilter, wizard internal slimming (liveRecord via the shared factory, import-gated gate spine, form-less affordance steps, URL-sync consolidation), d.ts two-tier comment policy (config-driven trimmer, Oswald signs the Tier-A cap), perf line items (FieldPort/identity memoization, watcher-scope consolidation, allocation cuts).
top_risks: Write-funnel single-walk rewrite is the correctness core: gate/strip/complete/author/patch phase ordering, DU same-tick no-flicker, blank-before-identity-short-circuit semantics must be pinned by characterization suites against BOTH zod majors before the kernel swap (Phase 5 is the riskiest phase; land it behind the full array/DU/display test matrix).

callableTree factory must reproduce subtle proxy behavior in one place: Vue renderList over array subtrees (array-target swap + length invariant), JSON/coercion parity, ownKeys liveness, and the memoized toJSON tree's invalidation; dropping the sucrase shims can break optional-chained call-forms in the @vue/repl playground specifically - verify the playground before deleting.

Compile-delivered directive: the withDirectives rewrite must land on BOTH client and SSR compiles including the component-host path (SSR_COMPONENT_HOST_MODIFIER + getSSRProps-fires-twice trap from #381/#404); the replay-stub's one-microtask-late first seed on no-plugin render-function mounts is an accepted, documented edge - confirm Oswald accepts it, else installVRegister is the documented fallback.

Deleting the zod rebuild machinery changes two observable behaviors (sync-check seeds on async-refine schemas defer one microtask affecting SSR serialize timing; slim-parse no longer strips unknown constraint keys) - needs explicit sign-off per the reference-before-API-change rule and re-baselined adapter suites; v3/v4 parity must be re-verified since v4 aligns DOWN to v3's deferred behavior.

Budget estimate risk: kernel (2.8k), surfaces (1.3k), and zod-core (1.7k) are ideal-design numbers with the least measurement behind them; the 1.65 kB reserve absorbs ~8% overrun. Mitigate by ratcheting per phase (measure after each landing, re-plan if a phase under-delivers by >20%) rather than trusting the sum.

Measurement methodology drift: check-eager-size must resolve the prod flavor once the development condition exists, and the new dynamic imports (activation, transforms-async, focus, host/file chunks) must stay off the import-statement eager walk under splitting:true - add a packaging test asserting each chunk's absence from reachableInputs.

Type-system landmines: the TS2589/Volar defenses (named walker aliases, StorageShape property-access pattern, ZodV4Internals brand, reflexive escape arm) must survive the adapter merge verbatim, and the FieldState/meta getter-vs-computed dependency tracking must stay identical through the FIELD_STATE_KEYS loop rewrite - bundled-types fixtures for both majors are the gate.
rejected_ideas: form-api-proxies' flagship rewrite (form.values = readonly(state.form), form.errors = computed plain tree, call-forms demoted to form.field(path)/form.errors(path) plain functions) AS SCOPED - it drops the callable-read API, which this architecture is mandated to keep; I take its deletions (memoized trees, mirror-loop generation, coercion-repair removal) but route all three surfaces through one callableTree factory instead (~0.4 kB more than their 0.9 kB estimate, callable DX intact).

Lazy-loading the array MUTATION half on first array detection (arrays-history finding 4, ~500 gz): the chunk-race fallback silently degrades one structural op to positional identity, violating the no-silent-degradation stance; the analyst themselves recommended skipping unless the window provably closes. The merged arrays engine stays eager.

Runtime lazy zod-adapter loading for the '.' barrel: useForm's introspection must be synchronous at first paint; instead the marginal second adapter shrinks to a ~1.1 kB probe pack and the build plugins keep aliasing to one major.
Flipping the '.' barrel to v4-only with v3 throwing: violates the locked zod v3/v4 first-class parity stance; unnecessary once the both-eager penalty is <2 kB.

Moving useWizard to an 'attaform/wizard' subpath: measured 0 eager benefit (it tree-shakes fully today); a breaking entry change buying only whole-entry size-limit cosmetics. Wizard slimming happens internally (Phase 7).

Deleting AbstractSchema.fingerprint from the SPI: it is already off the eager path and its dev key-collision diagnostic is real; I keep it as ONE shared lazy walker over the probe pack instead (halves the tarball copy, keeps the diagnostic).

Replacing unbuild with a raw rollup/esbuild pipeline: the shared-chunk splitter is what guarantees single registry/core instances across 12 entries (cross-entry identity), and the three config switches already reach the tarball target; re-solving solved problems for zero bytes.

Collapsing rollup/esbuild/webpack/rspack into one './plugin' entry: per-bundler subpaths are the unplugin-ecosystem convention, the cost after the packaging fixes is ~10 kB packed, and entry churn spends consumer-facing continuity on taste.
Symbol.for description diet ('attaform:...' -> 'af:...', ~110 gz): real debuggability and devtools-legibility loss for a below-threshold win.

Removing the catchOnUseDefaultFalse divergence knob now (60 gz): it is an observable v3 behavior change requiring its own sign-off conversation; too small a win to couple to this program - revisit standalone with Oswald.

PathKey-as-dotted-string / dropping the '' field key (defensive-code open question): would double the paths savings but changes a public key format with unresolved consumers (SSR payloads, wizard URL); the interned-trie design captures most of the win without betting on that answer.

claim: zod-core + probe packs: delete strip/rebuild/clone machinery via a data-walk fix pass over derived defaults (1300), kindOf as data + shared tree-walk predicates (500), falsely-divergent services into shared factory (150), prototype-based adapter class absorbing abstract-schema-factory (250), field-meta dedupe (30), dead exports (60) - v4-minimal zod stack 6.8->~3.6 kB gz; both-majors total ~4.5 kB vs 12.3.
